Accused No.1 in crime No.116/2023 registered by Yeshwanthpura Police Station for the offences punishable under Sections 21(1)(2)(3) of the Banning of Unregulated Deposit Schemes Act, 2019 and Sections 506, 341, 34, 504, 420 and 324 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('the IPC' for short) is before this Court seeking the regular bail.

sentences.text:
2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned HCGP appearing for the respondent.
3.

On the basis of the complaint lodged by Smt. Prema Kadlimatti W/o Somashekar M. dated 11.04.2023, Yeshwanthpura Police had registered an FIR in crime No.116/2023 for the aforesaid offences as against the petitioner and the eleven others.

In the complaint it is averred that on the representation of accused No.10 and her husband, accused No.2, the complainant had invested huge amount in the Company known as Multi Billion Dollar Business Company.
NC: 2023:KHC:29297 The accused persons allegedly had assured good returns on the investment.
However, they had failed to keep up their promise and therefore, the complainant and others who had invested money in the Company had requested to refund the amount deposited by them.
It is alleged that the investment made by the complainant and others was transferred to some other Company without their knowledge.
It is alleged that the accused persons have totally collected a sum of Rs.1,38,00,000/- and have cheated the complainant and other public.
It is in this background she had approached the Police and lodged the complaint.

4. During the course of the investigation, the petitioner was arrested on 13.04.2023, his bail application filed before the Court of the Principal City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru in Crl.Misc.No.3704/2023 was dismissed on 15.05.2023.

entities.text: Principal City Civil and Sessions Judge, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is under these circumstances, the petitioner is before this Court.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed on 08.06.2023.

The alleged NC: 2023:KHC:29297 offences are triable by Court of Magistrate and the maximum punishment for the said offence is imprisonment up to seven years and therefore, prays to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
She also submits that this Court has granted interim bail to the petitioner on 05.06.2023 and he has not Sri.

sentences.text: Accordingly, prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the bail application and submits that there are serious allegations of cheating against the petitioner and therefore, prays to dismiss the petition.

7. From the perusal of the complaint averments, it is seen that the complainant and the others have invested money in the Company managed by the accused persons and it is their case that the accused persons had promised good returns on their investment.

On the ground that the accused persons have not kept up their promise and not paid the returns in respect of their investment and also have not repaid the amount invested by the complainant and others, the complaint is lodged.
During the course of the investigation, the petitioner was arrested on 13.04.2023.
The police have completed the NC: 2023:KHC:29297 investigation and filed a charge sheet against the petitioner and others for the aforesaid offences on 08.06.2023.
The petitioner was granted interim bail by this Court on 05.06.2023 on the ground that the petitioner's mother was admitted to the hospital and her condition was serious.
After granting the interim bail, the Police have filed the charge sheet against the petitioner on 08.06.2023.
There are no allegations against the petitioner that he has violated the bail conditions.
The maximum punishment for the offences alleged against the petitioner and other accused persons is seven years imprisonment.
Under these circumstances, I am of the view that the petitioner has made out a prima facie case for grant of regular bail.
8. Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
